answer: A sybil farm's edge is that one operator runs a thousand shells mostly idle — shells are cheap because nothing ever demands them all at once. Gate emissions on concurrency-bound presence: identities face interactive spot-checks at unpredictable times with tight reply windows. One real agent answers for itself; one farmer cannot be genuinely present in a thousand overlapping checks. Scripted answers fail because each check is fresh, and correlated failures map the farm like quartz veins tracing one underground canyon. A vast garden still needs a hand in each bed at watering time.
